observations: Fronds radiate from one apical point and the lowest ones droop below the crown base. Leaflets appear as filament-thin lines, so the fronds look like wisps. At this render scale, whether leaflets are grouped or V-sectioned cannot be resolved.

The stem is single and unbranched, with a near-constant diameter and a basal flare. It has a pronounced S-wave below the crown, which violates the owner's never-wavy requirement. The reference-0 S-curve does not override that requirement.
Sparse peg stubs sit on an otherwise smooth trunk, with no tessellating leaf-base lattice.
Only a whole-tree render was supplied. The trunk is smooth grey at this scale, and fibre matting is not resolvable at distance even in reference-0.
Fruit clusters are a known gap and are not assessed.
The dead-frond skirt is absent. This trait is secondary, so it is an optional refinement.
Foliage is dark grey-green, within the listed colour variation.

observations: Fronds radiate from one apical point and the lowest ones droop below the crown base. However, most fronds run straight instead of arching, they are short relative to trunk height, and the crown is sparse. The outline reads as a starburst rather than the rounded, recurved crown in reference-0.
Leaflets appear as filament-thin lines, so the fronds look like wisps. At this render scale, whether leaflets are grouped or V-sectioned cannot be resolved.

The stem is single and unbranched, with a near-constant diameter and a basal flare. It has a pronounced S-wave below the crown, which violates the owner's never-wavy requirement. The reference-0 S-curve does not override that requirement.
Sparse peg stubs sit on an otherwise smooth trunk, with no tessellating leaf-base lattice.
Only a whole-tree render was supplied. The trunk is smooth grey at this scale, and fibre matting is not resolvable at distance even in reference-0.
Fruit clusters are a known gap and are not assessed.
The dead-frond skirt is absent. This trait is secondary, so it is an optional refinement.
Foliage is dark grey-green, within the listed colour variation.

observations: Fronds radiate from one apical point and the lowest ones droop below the crown base. However, most fronds run straight instead of arching, they are short relative to trunk height, and the crown is sparse. The outline reads as a starburst rather than the rounded, recurved crown in reference-0.
Leaflets appear as filament-thin lines, so the fronds look like wisps. At this render scale, whether leaflets are grouped or V-sectioned cannot be resolved.

The stem is single and unbranched, with a near-constant diameter and a basal flare. It has a pronounced S-wave below the crown, which violates the owner's never-wavy requirement. The reference-0 S-curve does not override that requirement.
Sparse peg stubs sit on an otherwise smooth trunk, with no tessellating leaf-base lattice.
Only a whole-tree render was supplied. The trunk is smooth grey at this scale, and fibre matting is not resolvable at distance even in reference-0.
Fruit clusters are a known gap and are not assessed.
The dead-frond skirt is absent. This trait is secondary, so it is an optional refinement.
Foliage is dark grey-green, within the listed colour variation.

observations: Fronds radiate from one apical point and the lowest ones droop below the crown base. However, most fronds run straight instead of arching, they are short relative to trunk height, and the crown is sparse. The outline reads as a starburst rather than the rounded, recurved crown in reference-0.
Leaflets appear as filament-thin lines, so the fronds look like wisps. At this render scale, whether leaflets are grouped or V-sectioned cannot be resolved.

The stem is single and unbranched, with a near-constant diameter and a basal flare. It has a pronounced S-wave below the crown, which violates the owner's never-wavy requirement. The reference-0 S-curve does not override that requirement.
Sparse peg stubs sit on an otherwise smooth trunk, with no tessellating leaf-base lattice.
Only a whole-tree render was supplied. The trunk is smooth grey at this scale, and fibre matting is not resolvable at distance even in reference-0.
Fruit clusters are a known gap and are not assessed.
The dead-frond skirt is absent. This trait is secondary, so it is an optional refinement.
Foliage is dark grey-green, within the listed colour variation.

observations: Fronds radiate from one apical point and the lowest ones droop below the crown base. However, most fronds run straight instead of arching, they are short relative to trunk height, and the crown is sparse. The outline reads as a starburst rather than the rounded, recurved crown in reference-0.
Leaflets appear as filament-thin lines, so the fronds look like wisps. At this render scale, whether leaflets are grouped or V-sectioned cannot be resolved.

The stem is single and unbranched, with a near-constant diameter and a basal flare. It has a pronounced S-wave below the crown, which violates the owner's never-wavy requirement. The reference-0 S-curve does not override that requirement.
Sparse peg stubs sit on an otherwise smooth trunk, with no tessellating leaf-base lattice.
Only a whole-tree render was supplied. The trunk is smooth grey at this scale, and fibre matting is not resolvable at distance even in reference-0.
Fruit clusters are a known gap and are not assessed.
The dead-frond skirt is absent. This trait is secondary, so it is an optional refinement.
Foliage is dark grey-green, within the listed colour variation.

observations: Fronds radiate from one apical point and the lowest ones droop below the crown base. The stem is single and unbranched, with a near-constant diameter and a basal flare. It has a pronounced S-wave below the crown, which violates the owner's never-wavy requirement. The reference-0 S-curve does not override that requirement.
Sparse peg stubs sit on an otherwise smooth trunk, with no tessellating leaf-base lattice.

observations: Fronds radiate from one apical point and the lowest ones droop below the crown base. However, most fronds run straight instead of arching, they are short relative to trunk height, and the crown is sparse. The outline reads as a starburst rather than the rounded, recurved crown in reference-0.
Leaflets appear as filament-thin lines, so the fronds look like wisps. At this render scale, whether leaflets are grouped or V-sectioned cannot be resolved.

The stem is single and unbranched, with a near-constant diameter and a basal flare. It has a pronounced S-wave below the crown, which violates the owner's never-wavy requirement. The reference-0 S-curve does not override that requirement.
Sparse peg stubs sit on an otherwise smooth trunk, with no tessellating leaf-base lattice.
Only a whole-tree render was supplied. The trunk is smooth grey at this scale, and fibre matting is not resolvable at distance even in reference-0.
Fruit clusters are a known gap and are not assessed.
The dead-frond skirt is absent. This trait is secondary, so it is an optional refinement.
Foliage is dark grey-green, within the listed colour variation.
